title: Pampanga Marathon 2026 Review: SMOKE10's Clark Full Marathon
seo_title: Pampanga Marathon 2026 Review | Clark Philippines Race
meta_description: Pampanga Marathon 2026: September 13 at Clark Parade Grounds. Full marathon from SMOKE10 Events on Clark's famously fast roads.
dek: Set for 13 September 2026 at Clark Parade Grounds, this SMOKE10 Events marathon brings a full 42K to one of the Philippines' fastest road-running venues.
verdict: The Pampanga Marathon is a SMOKE10 Events full marathon at Clark Parade Grounds — one of the Philippines' premier running venues with wide, flat, traffic-free roads that are genuinely PB-friendly. Four distances (42K, 21K, 10K, 5K). SMOKE10's extensive Clark-based race portfolio means experienced local production. September in Pampanga is the tail of the wet season. For runners wanting a fast-course Philippine marathon at a proven venue, this is a strong regional pick.

sections.heading: Clark: The PB Factory
paragraphs: Clark Freeport's wide, flat boulevards — legacy of the US airbase — provide one of the Philippines' fastest marathon surfaces. [1] SMOKE10 Events has deep experience producing Clark-based races. September conditions are warm and humid.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: A Clark full marathon on fast roads. 13 September 2026 at Clark Parade Grounds. [1]
